title: Kurdish Sign Language
description: Deaf sign language of the Kurds of Iraq
extract: Kurdish Sign Language is the deaf sign language of the Kurds of Kurdistan Region, Iraq. There are three dialects, associated with the three Kurdish schools for the deaf in Sulaymaniyah, Erbil and Duhok. It is unintelligible with Iraqi Sign Language.
